$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the care pack composed with a neuropsychological assessment practice's content seed, re-registered in the colophon register (a university press: cream paper, oxblood ink, one book serif with its drawn small capitals, a printer's star) with its own pinned page skeletons. Everything else — pages' builders, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Neuropsychology Practice with a Sample Report
description: An assessment practice's site with real online booking: Cambridge Neuropsychology, three neuropsychologists off Brattle Street in Cambridge, Massachusetts evaluating ADHD, autism, learning differences, and memory for children and adults. It opens full-bleed on a psychologist and a boy laughing over a block-design puzzle ("Understand how you think."), then its argument — an annotated sample report on paper, no patient and no date, its four parts explained in numbered margin notes — then the three appointments that produce one (testing day, feedback, the written report), fees from $2,800 with superbills for out-of-network claims, how paying works, the clinicians, words from parents and adult clients, a plain FAQ, and a booking page offering a free intake call. The booking form is clinically empty — name, contact, visit type, new/returning.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so these practice and appointments seeds replace the base pack's at compose and mirror THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twins) — the composed template's Manage editors and booking widget open on the assessment practice, not the base clinic.

providers.name: Dr. Ji-woo Seo
providers.bio: Ji-woo is a board-certified pediatric neuropsychologist who trained in hospital clinics before opening the practice. She evaluates children and teenagers for ADHD, autism, and learning differences, and she writes reports a parent can read at the kitchen table.

providers.name: Dr. Elena Ferrer
providers.bio: Elena evaluates teenagers and adults — many of them late-identified, many of them tired of being told they're fine. She is bilingual in Spanish and English and sees a lot of graduate students and new parents.

providers.name: Dr. Marcus Bell
providers.bio: Marcus works with adults worried about memory, attention after a concussion, or changes they've noticed in a parent. He spent a decade in a memory clinic and is known for explaining a test score without a single acronym.

services.name: ADHD evaluation
services.description: For children and adults: attention, organization, and what actually helps at school or at work.

services.name: Autism evaluation
services.description: For children, teenagers, and adults, including people who have spent years masking.

services.name: Learning evaluation
services.description: Reading, writing, and math — dyslexia, dysgraphia, dyscalculia — with recommendations a school can use.

services.name: Memory & cognitive evaluation
services.description: For adults noticing changes in memory or thinking, after a concussion, or before a treatment decision.

services.name: Gifted & twice-exceptional
services.description: For bright children whose grades, behavior, or boredom don't add up.

services.name: School meetings
services.description: We join the IEP or 504 meeting, in person or by video, to explain the findings.

reviews.quote: We finally had a picture of our son that made sense, and a list of things to try on Monday. The school took the report seriously on the first read.
reviews.name: R. & D. P.

reviews.quote: I was diagnosed at thirty-four. Dr. Ferrer's report explained twenty years of my life in eleven pages, and it was kind about it.
reviews.name: S. K.

reviews.quote: Dr. Bell walked my mother and me through every score. We left knowing what was normal aging and what wasn't.
reviews.name: L. M.

newPatient.title: An intake call
newPatient.body: Twenty minutes with a clinician about the questions you have. We'll tell you which evaluation fits, what it costs, and how soon we can start.

newPatient.title: Records and forms
newPatient.body: School reports, prior testing, and a few questionnaires for you, and for a teacher if it's a child's evaluation. Everything goes through a secure portal.

newPatient.title: Testing day
newPatient.body: About six hours with breaks, over one or two days. Bring glasses, snacks, and anything that helps you or your child feel settled.

newPatient.title: Feedback and the report
newPatient.body: A feedback session about a week later, and the full written report within three weeks.

types.name: Free intake call
types.description: A short call with a clinician about your questions and which evaluation fits.

types.name: Intake consultation
types.description: The first appointment of an evaluation: history, goals, and a plan for testing day.

types.name: Feedback session
types.description: We walk through the findings and recommendations together, in person or by video.

theme.$comment: The colophon register in its own oxblood: mode light opens the site in its native appearance (cream paper by day); dark is the same reading room after hours. Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-inks pages and app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared careShell chrome (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop): the press takes the split nav — the imprint at the left, the contents at the right.

landing.$comment: A pinned layout (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): style re-registers the base's pages in the colophon register, and pages carries exactly the skeletons careLanding.ts emits from this remix's contentSeed — the hero turns full-bleed and the content-gated sections (the spotlight as a sample report that leads the home ahead of the journey, the journey's numbered steps, menu, faq) appear because the seed asks for them — so the composed template's document reproduces its code config section for section (tests/View/Care/careLanding.test.ts reads this through composedLandingSeed).
